notes.title: Version 1.3.2 Update
notes.content:
New Features

 Option to skip the opening cutscene
 Pointer operation difficulty option (can be slowed down)
 Pointer movement changed to back-and-forth motion
 Initial quantity set to 1 when purchasing items
 Volume adjustment range reduced (to prevent audio clipping) and can be lowered further
 Naming prompt (defaults to a preset name if left blank)
 Debuff flashing effect
 Default shop name set to "Massage Master"
 High affection service panel (although it can't be accessed in the demo version, players complained that it was too empty, so it will be displayed)


Fixed Bugs

 Character panel name does not display custom names
 Fixed fullscreen issue after the opening cutscene
 Storage panel has no display at the start
 Consecutive clicks may cause checkout failure at massage ending


Potentially Fixed Bugs

 Character panel remains displayed after a massage session

notes.title: Version 1.3.1 Update
notes.content:
Confirmed bug fixes and new features:

 Added a tutorial
 Added material descriptions when selecting clients (part of the tutorial)
 The protagonist's portrait now appears before entering a custom name
 Added a confirmation prompt when selecting materials for clients
 Difficulty no longer affects prices (starting funds were adjusted instead due to decimal formatting issues)
 Fatigue calculation hidden
 The demo version allowing gameplay up to the second week


Temporary fix:
 Fixed a crash when starting a second playthrough (previously, restarting the second playthrough in-game caused a crash; now, reaching a bad ending will directly close the program)

notes.title: ⚡ Satisfy your client, or die on the spot! playtest is ready!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468587/f876fdc2f6891b21573a05f961db0dd3ab092f79.gif
Earthquake-level hemorrhoids, flood-like night sweats, fire-breathing rhinitis...  

Powerful mages unbutton their shirts and unzip their zippers, bringing their unspeakable troubles to you. Your job—make their bodies feel relieved.  

But if your technique is off... their reactions could be even deadlier than their conditions.  

💥 Click “Request Access” to start playing! The test will end in February.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468587/1ae48c7ad352bcb6e072e7ca5f0d8eacbaeb9b37.png  
💆 Your Tasks  
  
Massage Treatment – Choose the right position and pressure, don’t press your life away.  
Market Stocking – Carefully purchase essential oils and aromatic substances, or risk closing your shop.  
Survival Socializing – Explore the world, maintain client relationships, and uncover the dark side of the world.  
  
🤝 Playtest Clients Overview  
  
🥀 Erectile Dysfunction  
Juste, the youngest president of the Magician's Association, is powerful but has been criticized by women for his "impotence." Saving his family's honor relies entirely on your hands!  
🌸 Shoulder Inflammation  
Katya, your childhood friend, has been saving up to buy her deceased sister's leg at an auction. But now she has shoulder pain, and strange flower buds are appearing on her skin...  
🎤 Throat Inflammation  
Lucy, the kingdom’s top diva, has ruined her voice from constant performances, with bruises and smoke scars hinting at deeper injuries. Can she still sing?  
🐉 Rhinitis  
Zhu Rengong, a self-proclaimed "high school senior time-traveler," sneezes fire and has been hired to investigate the most terrifying attack in history. Still dreaming of a harem... will he survive?  
💦 Night Sweats  
Scyll, a nun, tormented by the pain and insults of her patients, faces homelessness due to uncontrollable night sweats. Her request for help is... unexpected...  
  
💥 A little flirting may enhance the mood, but smashing people's sensitive areas may get you killed. Extreme life-and-death massages, whether heaven or hell, it all depends on your skills!💥  
⚠️ Warning: This game currently does not support English.

However, feel free to add it to your wishlist to help boost the game's visibility and localization efforts! We’re working hard to bring more language options in the future, and your support makes a big difference. Thank you!
